entries.translation_pt: Djambi. Ritual realizado durante a noite em torno de uma fogueira e que, através da música e da dança num ritmo frenético, pretende levar ao transe os participantes, principalmente os doentes, com o objetivo de os aliviar ou curar.

entries.translation_pt: 1. E. Êlê so sa kapataji di tudu ngê ku sa vivu nê ku sa motxi. Ele é que é o capataz de todos os que estão vivos e que estão mortos. 2. Inclusive. Yôyô ngê, nê minixtlu, ku a mata. Muitas pessoas, inclusive ministros, foram mortas. 3. Nem. Nê zuji nê avogadu na pô blaga demanda se fa. Nem o juiz, nem o advogado conseguiram solucionar a questão.

entries.source_title: Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar
entries.notes: Forro column of the Portuguese–Forro comparison table (portugais cinza). ALUSTP Dicionário livre writes xindja ‘Cinzas.’ The two spellings are kept separate. Angolar was not copied from the same article.

entries.source: Rougé, Jean-Louis; Schang, Emmanuel. 2012. Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar. Sciences et Techniques du Langage 9. Local files: Forro lan.txt, Forro lan.pdf.
entries.source_title: Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar
entries.notes: Explicitly labelled forro, compared with Kikongo singila. French gloss as printed: ‘entrer en transe’. Portuguese and English are null because this source does not give them.

entries.source: Rougé, Jean-Louis; Schang, Emmanuel. 2012. Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar. Sciences et Techniques du Langage 9. Local files: Forro lan.txt, Forro lan.pdf.
entries.source_title: Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar
entries.notes: Forro TMA list: ka (imperfectif); saka ou ska ou xka (progressif); tava (antériorité). Portuguese and English are null because the labels are French. saka and xka are already in the ALUSTP dictionary; ska is this article’s additional spelling.

entries.example: e nunka bi naie fa
entries.grammatical_information: Commutes with na in the Forro discontinuous negation na … fa.
entries.source: Rougé, Jean-Louis; Schang, Emmanuel. 2012. Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar. Sciences et Techniques du Langage 9. Local files: Forro lan.txt, Forro lan.pdf.
entries.source_title: Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar
entries.notes: Interlinear as printed: /il/jamais/venir/ici/nég/. French free translation: Il n'est jamais venu ici. Portuguese and English are null because this source glosses in French. Not copied from ALUSTP nanta / nantan.

entries.example: e nunka bi naie fa
entries.source: Rougé, Jean-Louis; Schang, Emmanuel. 2012. Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar. Sciences et Techniques du Langage 9. Local files: Forro lan.txt, Forro lan.pdf.
entries.source_title: Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar
entries.notes: Interlinear gloss ‘ici’ in the Forro negation example. ALUSTP Dicionário livre writes nai ‘Aqui. Cá.’ The spellings are kept separate. Portuguese and English are null because this source glosses in French.

entries.example: xigada di zoze
entries.source: Rougé, Jean-Louis; Schang, Emmanuel. 2012. Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar. Sciences et Techniques du Langage 9. Local files: Forro lan.txt, Forro lan.pdf.
entries.source_title: Histoire des créoles et génétique: le cas de l’angolar
